legal_estate.observed_scope: Civilian tables of the Java and Madura residencies, including Djokjokarta and Soerakarta within the aggregate. Includes adjacent islands assigned to those residencies. Excludes Buitenbezittingen, including Bali and Lombok, and army and navy personnel. The Inlanders column is the contemporary administrative figure for indigenous residents. Private-estate returns were incomplete and the undercount is unquantified. Where two names are listed, both opening residencies remain separate administrations. The counts refer to their combined statistical area.
legal_estate.locator: 1898 and 1900 editions, Oost-Indië, II.I.A, printed p. 2.
legal_estate.method: Interpolate by day for each published registration category. Use largest remainders within each island category control so the 17 areas preserve all five opening totals.
legal_estate.definition: Contemporary colonial legal registration. The labels do not establish language, ethnic identity, religion, occupation or socioeconomic status.

occupation.method: Hold the observed territorial shares at opening and allocate persons by integer largest remainders.
